work.trace.title: How this came to be
work.trace.hint: Read from the record, link by link. Each link says where it was kept, and a link nothing kept says so.
work.trace.nothing.session: Nothing on the record names this session.
work.trace.nothing.quest: Nothing on the record names this quest.
work.trace.terminal: A terminal reads the same chain with `daoris-driver trace {{kind}} {{id}}`, which also says why a store did not answer.
work.trace.source.quests: the service's quest, as its moves replay
work.trace.source.events: this machine's record of the session
work.trace.source.rules: the rules file this machine wrote for it
work.trace.source.auto-landings: this machine's list of work due to land
work.trace.unread.sessions: The service's session records could not be read, so no session is read here.
work.trace.unread.quests: The service's quests could not be read.
work.trace.unread.landings: This machine's landings do not read, so no landing is read here.
work.trace.namedBy.quest: quest #{{id}} names it as where it came from
work.trace.namedBy.landing: the landing of session {{id}} names it
work.trace.ask.head: Ask #{{id}}
work.trace.ask.gap.unread: Ask #{{id}} could not be read from the service.
work.trace.ask.gap.not-found: Ask #{{id}} is not on the service: it holds no ask by that id, though {{namedBy}}.
work.trace.ask.intakeGone: Its intake, session {{id}}: the service holds no record of it.
work.trace.ask.wordsNone: The service answers none of your words: the ask is from before they were kept, which is not the same as none said. Its sentence:
work.trace.ask.wordsKeptFrom: Your words are kept from {{at}}. What you said before then is in its sessions' records.
work.trace.ask.goAheadsBefore: The service answers no go-aheads: the ask is from before they were kept.
work.trace.word.reopened: said to session {{session}} after it ended
work.trace.goAhead.near: asked again beside #{{near}}, whose words it shared
work.trace.quest.head: Quest #{{id}}
work.trace.quest.gap.unread: Quest #{{id}} could not be read: the service's quests did not answer.
work.trace.quest.gap.not-found: Quest #{{id}} is not on the service: it holds no quest by that id, though {{namedBy}}.
work.trace.quest.noAsk: On no ask: `{{from}}` asked it, so no words of yours, go-aheads or requirements hold it.
work.trace.quest.parent: A step of quest #{{id}}, published when that one closed.
work.trace.quest.awaits: Waits on quest #{{id}}, asked of the repository that knows.
work.trace.quest.held: Held: its done departed from what you required, and waits for your yes.
work.trace.quest.records: Session records on it, oldest first:
work.trace.quest.recordsUnread: Its session records could not be read.
work.trace.answer.unanswered: not answered: its done carries no answer to it
work.trace.answer.not-yet: not answered yet: a done answers it
work.trace.session.head: Session {{id}}
work.trace.session.openedUnknown: opened at a moment not recorded
work.trace.session.interrupted: not by you: the driver closed, or the clean-up found it orphaned
work.trace.session.answered: answered: it goes on at the driver's next look
work.trace.session.ownSignIn: no account named: the agent's own sign-in
work.trace.session.teammate: A teammate's record: it ran on another machine, which keeps its account, its tree, its record and its rules.
work.trace.session.chat: A chat on no quest: no quest and no ask to read.
work.trace.session.first: The first session on its quest.
work.trace.session.took: It took the quest through its own connector.
work.trace.session.starts: Its start, in the driver's words
work.trace.session.instructionCut: Handed an instruction of {{chars}} characters, of which its record keeps the first {{kept}}
work.trace.session.chatInstruction: No instruction: a chat opens on your own words.
work.trace.events.gap.not-an-id: Its id names no record on this machine.
work.trace.events.gap.none-here: This machine holds no record of it.
work.trace.events.gap.unread: This machine's record of it does not read.
work.trace.session.hard: {{count}} hard denial beside the agent's own
work.trace.session.hard_other: {{count}} hard denials beside the agent's own
work.trace.session.guarded: the tree guard holds it to its tree
work.trace.rules.gap.none-while-running: Rules handed: no file on this machine while it runs. Its agent takes no rules file, or there was nothing to hand.
work.trace.rules.gap.gone-with-run: Rules handed: not kept past its run, since the file goes when its run ends.
work.trace.rules.gap.unread: Rules handed: the file this machine wrote for it does not read.
work.trace.session.landedNoLine: Landed on `{{branch}}` from a line git named none of, {{at}}
work.trace.session.handed: handed to the plugin `{{plugin}}`, which did not push it
work.trace.session.removedInside: the clean-up removed it, its history inside `{{on}}`
work.trace.acceptedBy.auto: accepted automatically when its quest was done
work.trace.acceptedUnknown: who accepted it is not kept: it landed before landings kept it
work.trace.due.title: Due to land automatically
work.trace.try.nothing: nothing to land: its work made no commits
work.trace.try.held: its quest is held for your yes
work.trace.try.unreviewed: it waits for your review where it runs
work.trace.try.opinion: it waits for a second opinion before it lands
work.trace.try.exists: the branch already stands, and Daoris does not move it
work.trace.try.completed: the chain's branch is already merged, so moving it on would push work no pull request carries
work.trace.try.plugin-unready: landed; its plugin cannot land work here, so nothing was pushed
work.trace.try.plugin-failed: landed; its plugin did not push it
work.trace.try.already: its work reached a branch of yours another way
work.trace.try.carried: its work is already on the line or a branch of yours by content, so it was not landed again
work.trace.try.superseded: a newer session in its tree stands for it
work.trace.try.undone: its quest is no longer done
work.trace.try.off: its rule no longer accepts automatically
work.trace.landing.gap.unread: Landing: this machine's landings do not read.
work.trace.landing.gap.none: Landing: none. No branch landing names it, and its record keeps no acceptance of its work.
work.trace.landing.gap.unknown: Landing: no branch landing names it, and no record of it here could say whether its work was accepted.
work.trace.landing.gap.merge-accepted: Landing: merged into the line. Its record keeps your acceptance, and the merge's own commit is not kept.
work.trace.stood.gap.no-moment: Its record says no moment it opened, so nothing is read against one.
work.trace.standing.none: Standing answer for {{repository}}: none set now, and one cleared since is not kept.
work.trace.standing.moment-unknown: Standing answer for {{repository}}: set at a moment this machine does not say, so whether it stood then is not known.
work.trace.standing.before: Standing answer for {{repository}}, set {{at}}, before it started:
work.trace.standing.after: Standing answer for {{repository}}: set {{at}}, after it started. What stood before is not kept.
work.trace.goAhead.stood.asked-after: Go-ahead #{{number}}: first asked after it started
work.trace.goAhead.stood.waiting: Go-ahead #{{number}}: waiting on you when it started, and still
work.trace.goAhead.stood.answered-after: Go-ahead #{{number}}: answered {{at}}, after it started. Whether an earlier answer stood then is not kept.
work.trace.session.wordsBefore: {{before}} of your {{of}} words on ask #{{ask}} said before it started
work.trace.unrecorded: Session {{id}}: its landing names it, and the service holds no record of it.
